name: User Registration
summary: Guides a new person through registration, identity verification, profile completion, durable identity creation, and optional claim of guest-created value while keeping secrets outside the conversation.

goals.summary: Guide a new person through registration and completion of required onboarding information.

entryPredicate.expression: A guest or PendingIdentity has chosen to register and no durable identity has yet completed the requested registration outcome.

completionPredicate.expression: A durable identity and authenticated session are established, any approved guest-value claim is complete, or the registration is abandoned or escalated safely.

informationRequirements.summary: The reason registration was initiated, including any claimable guest value or invitation context.
Non-secret profile information required by the canonical registration journey.
Passwords, one-time codes, passkeys, provider tokens, and recovery codes.

decisionPoints.summary: Select new registration, existing-user resolution, or another permitted identity path.
Select the required standard verification component.

confirmationRequirements.summary: Require explicit user intent before completing durable account creation and claiming guest-created value.

secureInteractions.summary: Collect credentials and identity-verification proofs outside conversational context.
secureInteractions.resumeBehavior: Refresh registration and identity state, then continue from the next permitted action using only the sanitized result.

escalationConditions.condition: Registration may create or link a duplicate durable identity.
escalationConditions.outcome: Pause account creation and route to deterministic identity resolution.

escalationConditions.condition: Verification or fraud controls require lockout, cooldown, step-up, or human review.
escalationConditions.outcome: Stop conversational orchestration and use the prescribed security path.

lifecycle.pause: Persist registration progress, collected non-secret data, claimable-value references, and secure handoff state outside the transcript.
lifecycle.resume: Reload authoritative identity and registration state before recommending the next action.
lifecycle.abandonment: Stop without partially creating or claiming a durable identity; retain only data allowed by policy.
lifecycle.expiration: Expire stale PendingIdentity and secure-handoff state according to their independent policies.

presentationExpectations: Present registration as guided HR onboarding.
Explain that passwords and verification codes are entered only in secure controls.
Preserve and visibly reconnect any guest-created value after successful registration.
Provide an equivalent traditional registration wizard.
openQuestions: Should guest-value registration become a specialized child conversation once its canonical journey is authored?
Which registration action keys are safe to expose through the conversation?

sourceReferences.note: Split from the original HR Onboarding goal set on 2026-07-28.
